title: The gunship keeps its full-screen FLIR seat; its GROUND TRUTH · IMPACT view grows, reads in true colour, and the seat stops jumping
context: Owner, 2026-09-15, after trying the gunship lab (2026-09-15-gunship-lab): the laser's round-scope layout does not work as well for the gunship. The orbital laser and the gunship are two visual identities for two use cases. Keep the gunship's full screen as it is, make the ground-truth impact view bigger, show it in true colour rather than FLIR to set it apart, and look into distracting camera jumps, possibly linked to a new breach alarm or to changing weapons.
outcome: Option (a) over (b). 3edf53f: in the gunship seat the GROUND TRUTH · IMPACT monitor is min(44vw, 640px) wide at 16:10, and the seat's optic frames three blast radii of the selected gun (about 13 m, 33 m and 96 m for the rotary, Bofors and 105) from far enough back to stay inside the lens's 30° clamp. 5e84127: the monitor copies its region into its own canvas beside #td-app, outside the seat's night and FLIR CSS filters, so it reads in true colour while the main canvas keeps url(#flir). Two camera jumps were traced in code and fixed: a gun change set the field of view in one frame, and now eases over about 0.15 s; and a newly opened sinkhole group started the breach establishing shot even while a seat was manned, which no longer happens (the quake still sounds). The gunship lab stays in the Workshop as the tried alternative.
alternatives: (b) The gunship lab's round scope and telemetry for the gunship (1ace86d); tried and set aside by the owner.

Move the seat's FLIR from a CSS filter into a post-process pass so the monitor is drawn after it; not chosen because the gunship browser step asserts the canvas's url(#flir) filter, and a second canvas keeps that contract.
Keep the breach establishing shot in the seat but shorten it; rejected because any cut takes the gunner's camera mid-aim.
evidence: npm test (107 test programs) and npm run check green on 3edf53f and 5e84127.
The browser step's monitor assertion checks only its label, unchanged.
NOT browser-verified: the memory guardrail stayed at WARN. Whether other camera jumps remain is for the owner's next session in the seat.
